Chaos lab real processes, real failures

With 🤖 self-healing on, every broken server is repaired automatically, all at the same time, so there's no need to press Heal. Every fault opens an incident: you get an alert when it starts, another when the cluster has healed, and a report of what happened. Shortcuts: K kill · P partition · L loss · H heal · ? all.

      Keyboard shortcuts

      K
      Kill the busiest leader (SIGKILL)
      P
      Partition a random node
      L
      30% packet loss on a random node
      H
      Heal everything
      G
      Run Game Day (the selected experiments)
      M
      Toggle Chaos Monkey
      C
      Consistency details
      R
      Open the latest incident report
      A
      Open the alert history

      Search the logs
